description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Own the full lifecycle of consumer products, from spotting user needs and shaping product direction to building and shipping polished experiences. This role brings product strategy, design, and full-stack engineering together, with direct ownership of user value and engagement.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Define product positioning, scope features, and identify the smallest complete version worth shipping.

 - Design consumer user experiences, including onboarding flows, activation journeys, and interface copy.

 - Build reliable frontend and backend systems using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js.

 - Implement APIs, SQL data models, authentication, payments, and subscriptions.

 - Set up product analytics, experiments, and production monitoring to measure engagement and retention.

 - Deploy applications, debug production issues, and maintain reliable core functionality.

 - Use user feedback and retention analysis to guide iteration, pivots, or decisions to stop.

 - Ship polished MVPs or substantial product iterations in approximately 3 to 7 days.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience shipping consumer products end-to-end, from concept through production.

 - Production experience with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, APIs, SQL databases, and data modeling.

 - Hands-on experience implementing authentication, payments, and subscriptions, and deploying and debugging production applications.

 - Experience designing consumer product interfaces and setting up analytics and experiments to measure engagement and retention.

 - Familiarity with PostHog or similar analytics tools, plus AI development tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, while maintaining strong architectural judgment and code quality.

 - Consumer products, social apps, communication tools, cross-platform development, and independent end-to-end product work are valuable backgrounds.

 - A strategic, ownership-minded approach to identifying user problems and delivering outcomes.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $350,000 annually. Equity and visa sponsorship details were not provided.


LOCATION

On-site in Palo Alto, California, United States.
